title: I-trustworthy Models. A framework for trustworthiness evaluation of probabilistic classifiers
reasoning: The paper establishes a statistical framework for evaluating 'trustworthiness' through the lens of local calibration in probabilistic classifiers. While it addresses algorithmic bias and uses datasets often associated with AI ethics (like COMPAS), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems; instead, it provides a mathematical tool for auditing statistical parity and reliability.
